newspaper.headline: Callers Pretend to Be IT, Ask for OTP Codes
newspaper.lead: Several employees in the Nusantara business district report phone calls from people pretending to be IT staff and asking for OTP codes. Real IT staff never ask for that code.

impact.good: Yesterday, Nusa Digital's SOC analyst carefully told legit emails apart from fake ones. No client work was disrupted.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, some email traps got through and a few legit emails were blocked too. The SOC team is double-checking.
impact.bad: Yesterday, several email traps got through and legit work emails were blocked too. Clients have asked for a repair report.

tip.title: Tip: Your OTP Is a Secret
tip.text: An OTP (one-time code) is for you only. Anyone who asks for it, even someone claiming to be from a bank or the IT team, is suspicious.

newspaper.classified: THANK YOU to everyone who read their code out over the phone. You were a big help. — K.
sources: BSSN: advice on keeping your OTP secret

boss.title: The Code Hunter
boss.intro: Someone is after staff login codes from every direction. Stay careful: an unusual login is not always an attack.
